annotations.title: SEC deferred revenue and RPO momentum

description: SEC deferred revenue and RPO momentum — Leading-indicator check for subscription, software and contract businesses from SEC 10-K XBRL: remaining performance obligations (RPO), contract liabilities (deferred revenue), billings (revenue + change in deferred revenue), YoY growth of each vs revenue growth, and RPO coverage in years of revenue. Verdict ACCELERATING / IN_LINE / DECELERATING. Param ticker (or CIK). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
